newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up, NYMEX firm, short covering seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up, NYMEX firm, short covering seen.

text.p: Brent crude futures edged up on Friday, largely following NYMEX, but volume was extremely light, traders said.
August Brent crude on SIMEX was last traded at $17.83 per barrel on 46 lots after London settled at $17.78 overnight.
Brokers said the market was unsure of direction after London gained just one cent overnight.
NYMEX in New York fell 12 cents overnight to $18.67, which prompted some modest buying back of positions on ACCESS in Asia.
July was last traded at $18.72, up five cents from New York, which August was last traded at $19.00, up eight cents.
Brokers said the market might show a firm tone on Friday on short covering ahead of the OPEC meeting next week.
OPEC starts its meeting on Wednesday but ministers will arrive a few days before.
Traders have said they expect a roll over of OPEC's 25.033 million barrels-per-day supply ceiling and that the key issue will be how to curb quota violations.
